operators.name: Mattakeesett Moorings & Launch
operators.notes: The source describes annual Duxbury permitting and approval before installation, relocation, vessel or owner changes; use the relevant permit record for the actual job. Its approximate three-year chain/shackle replacement expectation depends on conditions.

operators.name: Triad Boatworks
operators.geography: Mattapoisett and Dartmouth, Massachusetts, United States
operators.notes: Hauled measurement, photographs and town reporting are distinct records. The stated three-year inspection cadence is tied to the relevant municipality; each actual mooring keeps its own requirements and operator-selected dates.

operators.name: Pioneer Mooring
operators.geography: SouthCoast Massachusetts and nearby Rhode Island, United States
operators.notes: Existing GPS equipment and positioning are operator capabilities. Treat the software demonstration as organizing their job and asset records around that existing workflow. The public address is a mailing/checks address.

operators.name: Campbell's Boat Works Inc.
operators.geography: Bourne and Falmouth, Massachusetts, United States
operators.notes: Six named rental harbors are places, not a mooring count. Keep each actual town permit and inspection requirement. The older Winter/Spring 2025 store promotions do not define current scheduling.

operators.name: Lower Cape Marine Services
operators.geography: Chatham and nearby Cape Cod waters, Massachusetts, United States
operators.notes: LCMS is the same company as Lower Cape Marine Services and capecodmooring.com. The website's combined team-experience wording is not a founding date. Float docks remain a separate asset class when the mooring workflow is demonstrated.

operators.name: Kennebec Marine Services
operators.geography: New Meadows, Kennebec, Sheepscot and Sasanoa rivers, Maine, United States
operators.notes: Municipality reports and completed field work remain distinct. Repair time and materials are explicit entries. The separately stated 300 seasonal clients concerns broader float/ramp service and does not establish a mooring inventory.

returned issues and correction where applicable
